operators.Construct: Introduce an explicit representation or structure.
operators.Differentiate: Record an explicit distinction relevant to the declared scope.
operators.Restrict: Limit admissible objects, relations, states, or transitions by an explicit constraint.

authority.authority_limitation: The authority supplies prose definitions but no transition semantics, equivalence relation, or candidate universe.

bounded_model.name: finite_coordinate_trace_v1
assumptions: R, D, and A are finite sets of explicit representations, recorded distinctions, and admissible items.
Construct adds exactly one member to R; Differentiate adds exactly one member to D; Restrict removes exactly one member from A.
Operators do not change either of the other two coordinates.
Observational equivalence is componentwise equality of (R,D,A).
Only finite monotone traces using those three coordinate effects are in scope.
excluded: semantic interpretation not reducible to recorded distinctions
bounded_model.claim: Under the operator-separating coordinate premises of finite_coordinate_trace_v1, Construct, Differentiate, and Restrict are jointly sufficient and individually irreducible under componentwise observational equivalence. The minimality result is induced by those premises and does not establish canonical or global operator necessity.

operators.name: Construct
operators.elimination: fails on W_C because R changes
operators.composition: arbitrary finite R additions compose from Construct
operators.equivalence: not equivalent to either other operator under componentwise equality

operators.name: Differentiate
operators.elimination: fails on W_D because D changes
operators.composition: arbitrary finite D additions compose from Differentiate
operators.equivalence: not equivalent to either other operator under componentwise equality

operators.name: Restrict
operators.elimination: fails on W_R because A changes
operators.composition: arbitrary finite A removals compose from Restrict
operators.equivalence: not equivalent to either other operator under componentwise equality

fourth_candidates.name: Resolve
fourth_candidates.reason: canonical Resolve applies a declared rule, but finite_coordinate_trace_v1 contains neither a rule representation nor a rule-execution transition; Restrict plus Construct can only record an already supplied result

fourth_candidates.name: Select
fourth_candidates.reason: selection among multiple admissible candidates requires a selection rule or execution effect absent from the bounded model

fourth_candidates.name: Transform
fourth_candidates.reason: finite replacement is representation of a new item plus restriction of the old item

fourth_candidates.name: Compare
fourth_candidates.reason: its observable product is a recorded distinction

fourth_candidates.name: Interpret
fourth_candidates.reason: canonical operator prose does not authorize reducing semantic interpretation to a recorded distinction

fourth_candidates.name: Observe
fourth_candidates.reason: external information acquisition is absent from the bounded trace model

fourth_candidates.name: Delete_or_relax
fourth_candidates.reason: the monotone operator effects cannot delete R/D records or add an item back to A

fourth_candidates.name: Merge
fourth_candidates.reason: identity-changing quotient effects are not specified by the three canonical prose definitions

strongest_claim: coordinate-separation-induced bounded minimality for finite_coordinate_trace_v1 only
remaining_obligations: Freeze canonical transition semantics independently of this evaluation.
Freeze an admissible open-world candidate universe and equivalence/cost preorder.
Model declared-rule representation and rule execution before adjudicating Resolve or Select.
Determine whether interpretation, observation, deletion, relaxation, or quotient/merge effects belong to the intended operator scope.
Supply lower bounds that do not assume coordinate locality if a stronger claim is sought.
